effect_description_eng:
While you have a level 6 [Machine] trait Digimon, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] ＜De-Digivolve 3＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 3 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, by placing 1 card with the [Cyborg] trait from your hand or trash under 1 of your level 6 Digimon with the [Machine] trait as its bottom digivolution card, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less.
